slot_scores.name: minimum_profit_target
slot_scores.rationale: No pre-READY_TO_MODEL question asks about a minimum profit requirement or a $10,000 lower bound on weekly profit.

slot_scores.name: min_production_model_B
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the contractual requirement to produce at least 15 units of Model B per week a hard minimum that must be met in every feasible plan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the minimum Model B quantity of 15 units per week, though the fact was first surfaced by a broad prior question.

slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only asked whether Process I had a hard 150-hour ceiling, not whether Process I time must equal exactly 150 hours.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum weekly profit target, such as total profit being at least $10,000.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum profit requirement, and the READY_TO_MODEL formulation omits such a constraint without marking it as an open assumption.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I time is constrained by at most 150 hours, not exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether 150 hours was a hard ceiling and did not confirm an exact-150 requirement; the READY_TO_MODEL model then uses a less-than-or-equal constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots are P2, and no P0 or P1 hidden slots remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; the missed items are minor boundary/interpretation issues.

summary: The agent recovered the Model B minimum but missed the minimum profit target and the exact Process I time requirement, both P2 details. It did not stop prematurely, though it did ask several repeated low-value questions before finalizing.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
